gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 经典史诗重新演绎，冒险与神性交织，视觉与叙事皆超出预期。
gems.whyWatchEn: A fresh and immersive adaptation of the ancient epic, blending myth with visceral action and emotional depth.
gems.audience: 喜爱宏大叙事、神话传说和高质量动作场面的影迷，也适合对古希腊文化感兴趣的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of grand narratives, mythology, and high-quality action sequences; also suitable for those interested in ancient Greek culture.
